description: M1: Physics Sandbox - Complete foundational physics system with playable ball-peg interactions

userStories.title: Add peg spawning to Board.gd
userStories.description: As a developer, I need pegs to be instantiated on the board so the physics sandbox is playable.
acceptanceCriteria: Load all 8 peg scenes: StonePeg, BonePeg, FungalPeg, EmberPeg, EyePeg, HeartPeg, OraclePeg, VoidRiftPeg
Place pegs in staggered grid pattern (~15-20 pegs total)
Position pegs between top (y=150) and pocket row (y=700)
Use proper spacing: columns ~70px apart, rows ~60px apart
Odd rows offset by half column width for staggered pattern
Add each peg to 'peg' group for collision detection
Balls can hit pegs and bounce realistically
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Physics Debug Overlay
userStories.description: As a developer, I need debug visualization to tune physics values and verify collision behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Show all collision shapes using draw_rect/draw_circle
Show ball velocity vector as arrow/line
Show peg hit_count labels above each peg
Connect to EventBus.peg_hit for console logging
Add PhysicsDebugOverlay to Board.tscn scene tree
Press F1 to toggle debug overlay visibility
Project compiles without errors in Godot
